label: a
rationale: Batches 1, 3, and 8 form the algebraic-structures cluster: group extensions and actions, complete reducibility of representations, and categorical subobjects, generators, and Grothendieck axioms are best reviewed together.

label: b
rationale: Batch 2 is the commutative-algebra singleton and batch 5 is the measure-theory singleton; pairing these residual categories is required by the four-group cap, and there are no cross-batch dependency edges to preserve.

label: c
rationale: Batches 4 and 9 are both combinatorics: spectral and algebraic graph theory connects naturally with cographs, perfection, and pure-pair structure, while keeping the entire category with one Alpha.

label: d
rationale: Batches 6 and 7 are the two complex-analysis batches, covering the Riemann sphere and normal families alongside holomorphic inverses and Weierstrass preparation; keeping them together preserves the analytic context.
